content_html:
It is a great feature, previously you had to use an addin to support it.
One change I would recommend is to type ‘about:config’ into the address bar, then type spell into the filter. Then change the ‘layout.spellcheckDefault’ option to a 2.
This will enable it for ALL fields on a form.

Spell checking is great.

The find feature is also great (although it’s been in FF forever).

The little things…
